title: Extended functionality
description: This mod adds new features to your game to make the player's life easier !
body:
![extended functionality](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25d224d7ecf9132aed48428b4b6c6092f7031251.png)

This mod adds new features to your game to make the player's life easier :

- Double doors open simultaneously when right-clicked.
- Putting rotten flesh in a furnace or on a campfire yields leather.
- Wool blocks can yield yarn when placed in a crafting table (any color).
- Putting vanilla raw ore blocks in a blast furnace smelts them.
- Cobwebs can be burned when left-clicked with a torch.
- Nascent amethyst blocks can be harvested with Silk Touch.
- It is possible to jump over wooden fences and gates.
- Honeycomb blocks can yield honeycombs in the crafting table.
- Giving bread to villagers with a right-click heals them.
- Right-clicking an unwaxed copper block with a bucket of water accelerates its oxidation.
- Right-clicking an entity on a vehicle immediately removes it. Sleeping fully restores the 
player's health.
- Milk and empty bottles yield stackable milk bottles.
- Falling from too high temporarily slows the player upon landing.
- Added the charcoal block (created the same way as the coal block but using charcoal).
- Bees are smaller and more realistically sized.
